page.content:
Three-headed hound who guards the gates of Hades.

How Cerberus connects

  • Location: Underworld — Cerberus guards the gates of the Underworld.
  • Character: Heracles — Heracles' last labor is to fetch Cerberus from Hades.

What is Cerberus?

Cerberus watches the Underworld so the dead cannot leave. Heracles' final labor is to drag the hound to the living world and return him.

Key threads lead to Underworld and Heracles.
